text:
mira: incident-bot fired for high paging on prod-gpu-pool-7, noticing sharp drop in throughput and some 5xxs. logs show steady kv_cache size growth per request. tagging oncall.
ryan: looking. metric link: https://grafana.company/internal/d/kv-cache?orgId=1&panelId=21 spike at 20:12 UTC, P95 latency doubled.
samir: saw this trending on our perf dashboard — cont-batch requests suddenly increasing kv footprint for awq-int8 models after last night's kernel selection roll.
elainE: @samir do you have the kernel-change CL?
samir: yes, CL 2345 toggled AWQ-kernel-preference for gptq->awq fallthrough. intent was speed wins but may have changed KV layout. snippet: ```kernel_selector.set_preference('awq', priority=10)```
oncall-bot: @ryan, @mira oncall rotation reminder: you are the primary for infra.
mira: I'm on it. first step: confirm if new kernel path increases kv size per token. can we replay a sample trace?
ryan: replayed a 512-token chat with master vs pre-rollout: kv bytes went from ~1.2MB to ~3.8MB with AWQ kernels on same model & batch config. that's 3x.
ops_lead: that's huge. why is continuous-batching amplifying this though?
samir: likely due to per-segment keying changes in newer attention kernels — they materialize larger key/value tensors for fused attention to speed matmuls, which interacts badly with cont-batch merging. cont-batch is concatenating prefixes and keeping KV in memory per unique prefix, net effect multiplies footprint.
elaine: customer impact? any reported user-facing errors yet?
customer-success-jess: saw 2 enterprise customers with elevated 5xxs and timeouts for a small percentage of requests. escalations inbound; CS on calls.
mira: ok triage plan: 1) immediate mitigation: throttle continuous-batching for affected model families 2) enable legacy kernel fallback for AWQ path 3) raise aggressive kv-eviction threshold 4) escalate to runtime team for a hotfix. agree?
ryan: +1. propose a quick flag: `CONT_BATCH_MAX_CONCURRENCY=8` per node and `KERNEL_SELECTOR=legacy_int8` for the AWQ family.
samir: legacy_int8 fallback validated on canary; perf hit ~15% but prevents kv blowups.
elaine: do we have safe rollout playbook to limit blast radius?
mira: yes — apply to pool-7 first as hotfix, watch pages and p95 for 10m, then roll to other pools. if paging persists, we'll take pool offline and shift traffic.
ops_lead: I've drafted the runbook steps in ops-runbook GDrive.
oncall-bot: deploy-bot: starting deploy 2154321105 by mira to pool-7 with env overrides.
mira: applying `KERNEL_SELECTOR=legacy_int8` on pool-7 now. command: ```kubectl set env ds/gpu-infer KERNEL_SELECTOR=legacy_int8 -n prod --selector=pool=pool-7```
ryan: also applying `CONT_BATCH_MAX_CONCURRENCY=8`, and bumping `KV_EVICTION_TARGET=0.6` (evict at 60% of cap).
ryan: logs show memory pressure dropping on pool-7 nodes within 90s. page-fault rate back to baseline.
samir: validating request traces: kv size per request back to ~1.3MB. continuous-batch combining reduced.
customer-success-jess: customers on call report reduced errors; one customer said tail latency back to normal. :thumbsup:
elaine: great. we still need a long-term fix: either update AWQ kernel to produce compact KV layout or make cont-batch respect kernel layout heuristics.
ops_lead: opening a P0 bug: BUG-INT-7832 with reproducer and perf traces attached. assigned to eng-runtime (samir).
samir: I'll own the bug. initial hypothesis: fused-attn kernel uses block indexing causing padded KV materialization; we can change cont-batch merge to compress contiguous zero-padding and avoid storing redundant kv segments.
mira: in parallel, we should remove kernel preference flip from last night's rollout and add a canary gating that measures kv-growth delta before promotion.
ryan: rollback CL ID 2345 is ready; suggest reverting selector until we have compressed-KV or a kernel that respects cont-batching.
elainE: timeline?
samir: I can push a patch to cont-batch merger to limit per-request kv growth in ~6-8h, then we can test. kernel team needs ~2 days for proper change.
customer-success-jess: flagged affected customers with ETA for full fix and explained mitigations (throttles + fallback). they're satisfied with interim measures.
ops_lead: postmortem owners: mira (incident commander), samir (root cause / fix), ryan (mitigation rollout), jess (customer comms). target postmortem draft in 48h.
mira: taking notes: impact window 20:12–20:25 UTC, approx 13 minutes. peak p95 latency ~2.1s -> 4.8s; error rate for affected customers ~1.3% during window.
ryan: saved canary config and commands in incident artifact: s3://infra-incidents/2154321000/artifacts.txt
oncall-bot: handoff: mira is passing to ryan for nights; ryan please monitor next 4h and escalate if we see any new kv growth anomalies.
ryan: acknowledged, will watch grafana alerts and traces. setting alert: `KV_FOOTPRINT_DELTA > 2x over 5m` to page eng-runtime.
samir: pushed interim cont-batch limiter to staging for validation. log line on limiter: `CONT_BATCH_LIMITER: blocked merge - predicted_kv_growth=2.7MB > threshold`
mira: also adding a new QA eval — generate long prefix sessions with AWQ kernel and measure kv growth per token, add as a gating test for kernel selector promotions.
customer-success-jess: closing loop with customers, will send a summary at EOD.
ops_lead: incident status: mitigated -> monitoring. moving to post-incident review. thanks team. :heart:
